title: Argentinian Grilled Lamb Salad
description: A flavorful salad featuring grilled lamb, fresh vegetables, and a tangy dressing.
instructions: In a small bowl, mix together salt and black pepper. Rub the seasoning mixture onto the lamb cubes.
Brush the lamb cubes with olive oil. Grill the lamb for 5-6 minutes per side, or until cooked to your desired level of doneness.
Let the lamb rest for 5 minutes before slicing it thinly.
In a large bowl, combine the mixed greens, red onion, and cherry tomatoes.
Slice the grilled lamb into thin strips and add it to the bowl with the salad.
Toss the salad with your favorite dressing and serve immediately.
